Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name
Join metabolism on metabolism.met_id = substrate.met_id
Join compound_records as substrate_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate_records.record_id
Join molecule_dictionary as substrate on substrate_records.molregno = substrate.molregno
Left Join compound_structures as substrate_structures on substrate.molregno = substrate_structures.molregno
Join molecule_dictionary as parent on metabolism.drug_record_id = parent.molregno
Left Join compound_structures as parent_structures on parent.molregno = parent_structures.molregno
Join target_dictionary as enzyme on enzyme.tid = substrate.tid
Filter enzyme.pref_name = 'UGT1A10'
Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name
Limit 200
